resources.name: Open-source DFT code capable of spin-polarized PBE+U with DFT-D3 (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, GPAW)

access.notes: Must support plane-wave or localized basis, pseudopotentials, and U correction. The agent selects any such code.

access.notes: Standard PBE pseudopotentials from public repositories (e.g., SSSP, GTH, or PAW datasets compatible with the chosen DFT code).
